Coast Guard Seizes Boat for Diesel Smuggling Off Mumbai

The Indian Coast Guard apprehended a fishing boat attempting to evade capture after allegedly engaging in diesel smuggling off the coast of Mumbai. The boat was found with 4,000 liters of illicit diesel, and reports indicate that 500 liters were dumped into the sea during the incident. The crew was taken into custody.
